issues.description: Query AgentTool.objects.filter(agent__owner=self.request.user) causes N+1 because AgentTool.agent ForeignKey triggers extra query per tool to fetch agent.
Agent.owner ForeignKey accessed without select_related, causing extra queries.
agent_name = serializers.CharField(source='agent.name') triggers extra query per execution.
AgentExecution.objects.get() should use select_related('agent') to avoid extra query.

issues.issue: Missing timeout configuration for LLM calls
issues.description: LLM.invoke() and llm.stream() calls have no explicit timeout. LLM calls could hang indefinitely.
issues.fix: Add timeout parameter to LLM initialization using OLLAMA_CHAT_TIMEOUT constant (120s)

issues.description: HTTP_TOOL_TIMEOUT=10s is reasonable. External API calls already use timeout.
AgentExecution.objects.filter().order_by('-started_at')[:50] uses Python slicing instead of Django Paginator.
issues.fix: Consider using DRF pagination for scalability

issues.description: Class attribute access is fast, no fix needed.
create_agent_engine() creates new AgentEngine for every request. Could be cached with django cache.
issues.fix: Consider caching agent configs for frequently used agents

issues.description: Identical prompts don't benefit from caching.
issues.fix: Consider caching based on message hash for non-streaming requests

issues.issue: Memory leak - message array grows unbounded
issues.description: debugMessages.value.push() called without limit. Memory grows with each message.
debugMessages.value = [...debugMessages.value] triggers full array re-render on every chunk.
issues.fix: Update specific message reference instead of spreading array

issues.description: If error occurs mid-stream, reader might not be properly cancelled.
issues.fix: Add try-finally to ensure reader.cancel() is called

fixes_applied: Added MAX_MESSAGES constant (100) to prevent unbounded memory growth
Added message trimming after each push in sendDebugMessage and streamChatMessage
Optimized reactivity to find and update specific message index instead of spreading array
Added reader?.cancel() in finally block for proper resource cleanup

summary: Performance review completed. Fixed 7 database N+1 query issues (added select_related to 4 querysets), added LLM timeout configuration (120s), and fixed 4 frontend issues including memory leak, unnecessary re-renders, and resource cleanup. Caching opportunities documented as future enhancements.
